changelog:
**Build for Jellyfin 12.**

- fix(active-streams): show the button in the video player top bar
 - fix(pause-screen): show the back button on the Jellyfin 12 pause screen
 - fix(audio-language): show "No dialogue" instead of the raw zxx code
 - fix(perf): defer body-observer subscribers and cut forced layouts
 - fix(tags): size tags from card width so they scale on small non-mobile displays
 - feat(custom-icons): add Moonbase to supported plugins ([#842](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/842))
 - perf(api): share concurrent identical GET requests in coreFetch
 - fix(subtitles): leave Jellyfin's own styles alone when custom styles are disabled
 - docs: subtitle styling modes, unsupported formats and turning it off
 - fix: keep JE header shortcuts on a single row ([#844](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/844))
 - fix: defer inactive Home tabs and stop stale Activity polling ([#845](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/845))
 - chore(ci)(deps): bump the github-actions group with 4 updates ([#847](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/847))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#848](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/848))
 - fix(details): preserve IETF languages for selected versions ([#843](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/843))
 - feat(player): show age rating, advisories and genres when playback starts
 - fix(release-dates): use Jellyfin's episode date so display order is respected
 - fix(header): stop header buttons folding into More and prioritize Random and Active Streams
 - fix(tags): pick a real episode with streams as the series tag source
 - fix(custom-icons): serve the Moonbase icon at the size it is drawn ([#851](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/851))
 - Translations update from Hosted Weblate ([#856](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/856))
 - fix(tags): select stream-bearing episodes consistently for series tags ([#855](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/855))
 - fix(custom-icons): match Segment Editor's real dashboard link ([#862](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/862))
 - feat(jellyseerr-search): support "Title (YYYY)" year filtering in search ([#860](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/860))
 - Add option to exclude library items from Seerr search results ([#858](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/858))
 - perf: cut JE request volume (TMDB cache, batched lookups, request priority) ([#870](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/870))
 - fix(url-guard): allow Podman's host.containers.internal link-local mapping ([#873](https://github.com/n00bcodr/Jellyfin-Enhanced/issues/873))
 - fix(config-page): stop 404ing on stale gfont font URL and branding probes
 - docs(config-page): note that v12 sidebar links are mobile-only
 - feat(locales): complete Estonian, Alemannic, Korean and Malayalam translations
description: A combination of the Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere userscripts, providing a comprehensive set of tweaks and features for Jellyfin.
name: Jellyfin Enhanced
overview: Jellyfin Enhanced and Jellyfin Elsewhere for a better Jellyfin experience.
